items.source: Finds all entities reachable via path.
items.translation: 通过路径查找所有可到达的实体。

解析聚合体内部的关系。

items.source: identifier - the combination of Id, map keys and list indexes that identify the parent of the entity to be loaded. Must not be null.
items.translation: identifier - 用于标识待加载实体的父对象的 Id、映射键和列表索引的组合。不得为 null。

items.source: path - the path from the aggregate root to the entities to be resolved. Must not be null.
items.translation: path - 从聚合根到待解析实体的路径。不能为 null。
